subject: Added async options to rhipe(now v0.60)

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Added async options to rhipe(now v0.60)
parts:
Hello,
I added an async option to rhex. When called e.g.

a <- rhmr(v, aync = TRUE)

the code returns immediately. The job status can be monitored by
simply typing 'a' in the console

> a

or by running rhstatus(a). To wait for completion, run rhjoin(a)
(note rhstatus can also be given a character string job id e.g "job_20090102_0001")

Regards
Saptarshi
